My recommendation is the ESR if you use an Apple Watch and want one consolidated charging setup. Just make sure its reduced 65W laptop output while the wireless pads are active is enough for your laptop.

One important distinction: the Anker is a wireless 3-in-1 charger, not a laptop charging dock. If your goal is a genuinely all-in-one solution, the ESR better matches your requirements.
